verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is an open-source robotics middleware framework that users run themselves. No vendor-operated service ingests user data, so an opt-out from AI training does not apply to this kind of product. The only training-related mention (rosbag saving synthetic data for training sets) is about the user's own datasets, not vendor use of user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
